lines.text: Old and nearly blind, Isaac tells Esau to hunt game and cook a tasty dish so Isaac can bless him.
Rebekah overhears Isaac and tells Jacob to bring her two choice young goats from the flock.
Rebekah dresses Jacob in Esau's finest clothes and puts camel's hair on his hands and neck.

wrong_details.true: the skins of the young goats

lines.text: Jacob tells Isaac he is Esau, and Isaac says the voice is Abraham's but the hands are Esau's.
Esau returns from the hunt, and Isaac trembles violently and says Esau's brother came deceitfully and took the blessing.
